policy: User selected v31.0 plus verified fixes; unreleased features remain separate work. Preserve interactive SU prompts, Kitsune Hide/SuList and authenticated manager handling.

selected_fixes.disposition: Port -g precedence over -G; copy the old primary group before growing the Rust Vec to avoid a dangling element reference.
Validate compression signatures and XZ header CRC; also recognize the valid empty bzip2 end marker.
Propagate decompression failure and remove partial output; additionally reject failed output opens before passing a descriptor to Rust.
Preserve the 512-byte Samsung SignerVer02 trailer after SEANDROIDENFORCE.
Retain original AVB2 descriptors when repacking; update the outer footer offsets without rewriting authenticated descriptor fields.
Search compressed zImage payload formats, preferring aligned offsets and retaining the unaligned fallback.
Sanitize module filenames using explicit control-character ranges; preserve uppercase letters rather than copying the upstream regex literally.
Already applied earlier in PR15: use Android-compatible DER ECDSA AVB1 signatures with independent verification.

already_covered.disposition: The bounded Kitsune consent launcher already clears the child signal mask before exec.
Existing connect_daemon callers already reject failed descriptors.
DbValues::get_text already maps SQLite NULL to an empty string for C++ and Rust readers. Confirmed on candidate 31014.

previous_failures: Truncated gzip kernel unpack returned success
Samsung SignerVer02 trailer was not preserved
Non-compressed ANDROID magic masked the ARM32 zImage payload
verification.final_candidate_acceptance: Exact candidate 31016 passes all eight AVD lanes; commercial-emulator lifecycle records are maintained separately.

additional_verified_fix.trigger: A resized compressed payload changes length by a value not divisible by four.
additional_verified_fix.before: Both size pointers moved by the rounded GOT delta; a subsequent unpack could read a truncated gzip stream.
additional_verified_fix.after: The size literal and tagged pointer track the exact compressed payload end; GOT alignment still uses its own delta.
additional_verified_fix.test: tools/boot_qualification.py zimage_payloads: independent zlib decode, exact pointers, aligned and unaligned payloads, repack/unpack and unchanged source.
